AC-001.rationale: Engineering and non-engineering routing, plus real multi-turn entry order.

AC-002.rationale: Original proposal replay: first canonical working SPEC precedes reply; no new parallel working snapshot or discussion journal.

AC-003.rationale: Short answers, mixed turns, read-only interjections and no-question completion.

AC-004.rationale: Wrong task, stale revision/hash and self-reported flags fail managed handoff and finish-turn.

AC-005.rationale: Confirmed reopen, implemented successor and legacy recovery without invented historical entry evidence.

AC-006.rationale: Skill/doc contracts, full regression, architecture and assembled distribution.

AC-007.rationale: Read-only working records remain unmaterialized until a complete adopted change contract exists.

AC-008.rationale: Candidate provenance and accepted/rejected/deferred states; unadopted candidates do not block completion.

AC-009.rationale: Real trusted desktop hooks trigger even when the model omits voluntary router/finish-turn calls.

AC-010.rationale: Persisted original-turn repair allowance survives continuations/restart; real failure and recovery traces required.

AC-011.rationale: Separate supported/trusted/loaded/fired evidence; missing, disabled, timeout and unsupported paths cannot pass.

AC-012.rationale: General repair/revalidation cannot reset the same original-turn one-repair budget.

AC-013.rationale: One canonical SPEC ID/path from working through confirmation, with readable current contract, decisions, pending discussion and gaps plus embedded provenance.

AC-014.rationale: Persist new information before the next question or proposal; unchanged information does not create a revision; actual desktop trace and one-repair budget.

AC-015.rationale: Resume saved decisions; reopen only with sourced premise changes and preserved decision history.

AC-016.rationale: Detect behavior, exception and acceptance gaps; investigate discoverable facts and remove resolved gaps.

AC-017.rationale: Automatically confirm a complete adopted contract in the original file, with actual multi-turn trace; confirmation does not grant implementation.

AC-018.rationale: Validate and migrate legacy snapshots, journals and notes without provenance loss, dual writes, authority refresh or repair-budget reset; failures preserve originals.
